fields.label: Data Quality Gate
fields.description: Require selected fields to be filled and correct before a lead is qualified/converted — even non-mandatory fields.

fields.label: Enforce On
fields.options:
Qualify or Convert
On Save
Both
fields.description: When to enforce. 'Qualify or Convert' lets raw leads be captured but blocks incomplete data when moving forward.

fields.label: Gate When Leaving Status
fields.description: Comma-separated Lead status value(s). Under 'Qualify or Convert' (or 'Both'), the gate fires when status is changing away from one of these — not into a specific status — so it works with any custom status list, including this site's own (Lead, Interested, Qualified lead, Proposal sent, Won, ...). Default 'Lead' means: nothing else here matters if you never leave the initial status, but complete data is required the moment you try to move it anywhere else.

fields.label: Block if Incomplete
fields.description: If off, incomplete data only warns instead of blocking.

fields.label: Skip for Auto-captured Leads
fields.description: Do not gate leads created by the intake / WhatsApp webhooks on capture.

fields.label: Minimum Completeness %
fields.description: 0 = no percentage gate. Otherwise the required-field completeness must reach this %.

fields.label: Auto-create Lead when PreLead is Interested
fields.description: When a Prospect is set to a status whose behavior is 'Convert to Lead', a Lead is created automatically with the same owner.

fields.label: Send Created Lead for Review
fields.description: Auto-created Leads start at 'Pending Review'. If off, they start 'Approved'.

fields.label: Convert PreLead To
fields.description: Direct: create an ERPNext Lead immediately. Smart Lead: create an AlphaX Smart Lead for structured data entry that maps into the ERPNext Lead on submit (when the Smart Lead module is enabled).

fields.label: Enable Accounting Dimensions on PreLead
fields.description: Off by default. Lead and Opportunity get every active Accounting Dimension unconditionally; PreLead is opt-in and separately restricted to the fields listed below, so turning this on doesn't dump every dimension onto the calling-list form.

fields.label: PreLead Dimension Fields
fields.description: Comma-separated dimension fieldnames to show on PreLead (a subset of what's active site-wide). Default is Cost Center only. Fieldnames come from Setup > Accounting Dimension (e.g. cost_center, department, business_division, employee_cost_center). Cost Center is special-cased: since a PreLead can belong to more than one, it shows as a Cost Center + split % table (same pattern as AlphaX Smart Lead) rather than a single dropdown.

fields.label: AI Base URL
fields.description: Ollama-compatible local endpoint. No data leaves the host.

fields.options: <div class='text-muted small'>Install a free, local AI model (Ollama) once on a shared office PC/server, then every AlphaX CRM user gets AI Assist through it — no data leaves your network to a third-party AI vendor. Pick your server's operating system below to download a ready-to-run setup script: it installs Ollama, lets you choose a model size, and opens a secure tunnel so this site can reach it. When the script finishes it fills in AI Base URL and Model above on its own — nothing to copy or paste. Save this form once, then use Test AI Connection to confirm it works.

fields.label: Secure Remote Access (Named Tunnel + Cloudflare Access)
fields.description: Optional, for production use once the quick tunnel above has proven the setup works. A quick tunnel (*.trycloudflare.com) is a plain, unauthenticated public URL that changes every restart — fine to get started, not something to leave running long-term. A named Cloudflare Tunnel keeps a fixed address, and putting it behind Cloudflare Access with a Service Token means Cloudflare rejects every request at its edge — before it ever reaches your machine — unless it carries the two secret headers below. No one browsing to the tunnel URL directly can reach your AI server; only this CRM, using these credentials, can.

fields.options:
One-time setup, on the machine running Ollama and in the Cloudflare dashboard:
  1. Add a domain to Cloudflare (free plan is fine) if you haven't already.
  2. cloudflared tunnel login, then cloudflared tunnel create alphax-ollama.
  3. cloudflared tunnel route dns alphax-ollama ai.yourdomain.com.
  4. Point the tunnel's config at http://localhost:11434 and run it as a service (cloudflared service install) so it survives reboots.
  5. In the Cloudflare Zero Trust dashboard: Access → Applications → add ai.yourdomain.com, with a policy requiring Service Auth (not a login page — this CRM is a server calling another server, not a person in a browser).
  6. Access → Service Auth → Service Tokens → create one. Copy its Client ID and Client Secret into the two fields below.
  7. Set AI Base URL above to https://ai.yourdomain.com, save this form, then use Test AI Connection.
